title: Cube: single-player game support
description:
Verify the engine handles a single-player game.

## What to test
- players: ["solver"] — only one player
- turn_order: {"type": "alternating", "players": ["solver"], "actions_per_turn": 1}
- current_player() always returns "solver"
- turn_index never advances past 0
- No opponent-related logic fires (captures, etc.)

## Potential issues
- Does advance_turn() work with 1 player? turn_index = (0+1) % 1 = 0. Should be fine.
- Do end conditions work when there is no "opponent"?
- Does the agent framework handle single-player (always your turn)?

## Test
Create a minimal single-player game definition, play a few moves, verify the session works correctly. Both Rust and Python.
